recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant studio portrait of two men in oversized 90s-era fashion, set against a multi-colored neon gradient background with a vertical blue sidebar and bold, layered typography in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical blue bar on the left framing the composition
Subjects positioned centrally, overlapping the background and foreground text
High-contrast neon colors (pink, green, yellow) against dark clothing
Stacked typography with distinct color and weight variations
coreInvariants: Neon gradient background with a central white glow
High-key studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures standing centrally, scaled to occupy the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold magenta text in the bottom third acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subjects' faces, moves down their long coats to the green text, and finally rests on the heavy magenta text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space in the upper corners and along the left blue margin.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neon Green and Magenta for foreground elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blue for the vertical sidebar and dark neutrals for the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and white highlights within the background gradient.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and text creates a 'pop' effect against the lower-value clothing of the subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely condensed lowercase for the top line
Wide, bold uppercase for the bottom line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed lowercase and wide-set bold uppercase.

preserve: Color contrast between the two lines of text
The vertical blue bar on the left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the narrow, high-impact feel of the top line.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Franklin Gothic Heavy or Montserrat Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and width for the bottom line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two men in 90s oversized fashion (long coats, sunglasses, hats) against a neon gradient background (green, yellow, pink) with a solid blue vertical bar on the left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the bottom third. The top line should be ultra-condensed lowercase in neon green. The bottom line should be bold, wide uppercase in magenta, overlapping the subjects' legs.

verificationChecks: Is the blue sidebar present on the left?
Are the two lines of text distinct in color and weight?
Does the background feature a neon gradient?
Are the subjects wearing oversized 90s-style clothing?

adjustableVariables: Specific neon colors in the gradient
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any trademarked logos or specific brand names
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the background
Gradient transition is smooth without banding
The blue sidebar does not obscure the subjects
Typography follows the specified case rules (lower then upper)
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dual-subject studio portrait with a 90s neon gradient, a left-aligned color block, and high-contrast stacked sans-serif typography.
